topic: A33 combined target and draft vocabulary-sharded greedy sampling on original A0

excluded: A1 target compile, opaque attention op, or attention preparation fusion
A5 draft attention metadata reuse or fused multistep capability
MoE, GEMM1, GEMM2, TP fusion, sparse PA, score grid, or merge changes
A30 batch-sharded sampling or standalone non-sharded A31 dispatch
Changes to precision, LM heads, model computation, acceptance rates, or workload

necessary_dependencies.name: Local target logits access
necessary_dependencies.detail: Add only compute_logits_local to the AMD causal model and VL wrapper. A0 LogitsProcessor already supports skip_gather=True; its projection, scaling and soft-cap implementation remain unchanged.

necessary_dependencies.name: Shared greedy verification kernel
necessary_dependencies.detail: A33 sharded target sampling imports _greedy_verify_and_count and its _greedy_global_argmax dependency. Derive only these exact functions and their imports from the A33 greedy_rejection_sampler.py. Do not copy its unused full-logit stats kernel or Python entrypoint; A0 rejection_sampler.py and its fallback stay byte-identical.

necessary_dependencies.name: Draft load-time validation and sampling selection
necessary_dependencies.detail: Port the A33 private flag, identity draft-to-target mapping validation, and branch in DraftModelSpeculator._greedy_sample_draft. A0 Eagle3/autoregressive callers and metadata construction already support this hook and are byte-identical to their A33 exports.

necessary_dependencies.name: Existing A0 APIs
necessary_dependencies.detail: The generator verifies byte equality between A0 and A33 for 11 consumed sampling, LM-head, input-batch, draft-caller, and TP-group API files. No dependency on another ablation arm is required.

runtime.identity: Parent-provided non-root user with explicit HOME, USER and LOGNAME on every runtime invocation

parent_preflight: Parent builds through ../build_arm.sh r04_sampling using this arm's Dockerfile, named digest-pinned A0 base_ref and payload. Preserve all original A0 environment and runner settings except the two private sampling switches.

The shared ../audit_overlay.py audits installed payload hashes; patch_manifest.json remains provenance rather than a required common-runner schema. Also verify the 11 unchanged dependency hashes and installed module paths. Do not let bind mounts or PYTHONPATH redirect imports to dirty or cumulative sources.
Use the base image interpreter /usr/bin/python3 and explicitly supply HOME, USER and LOGNAME for every runtime invocation.

Confirm the active GPUModelRunner is vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_runner, the AMD MiniMax-M3 VL wrapper exposes compute_logits_local, and the language model is the A0 implementation plus the two listed local-logits methods.

Require both startup messages: Vocabulary-sharded greedy verification enabled: TP4 and MiniMax-M3 fused draft argmax enabled. Require runner.sharded_greedy_verifier is not None and speculator._use_minimax_fused_draft_argmax is True; logs alone do not prove replay activation.
Confirm TP4/PP1, vocab 200064 with contiguous local width 50016, hidden dimension 6144, the original BF16 draft LM head, identity D2T, scale 1.0 and no soft cap.

Keep greedy Eagle3 draft sampling and the original synthetic rejection configuration. Eligible target requests require temperature 0, no logits processors or requested logprobs, no grammar/structured output, no draft logits, no LoRA, no batch-sharded sampling, no adaptive/block verification, no trace replay, no sampling mask, and no NaN diagnostics.
Unsupported target requests deliberately use the unchanged A0 fallback; do not treat a successful fallback-only run as an active R4 measurement.

activation_checks.input: Map TP ranks 0,1,2,3 to Chrome traceEvents from an eligible, replay-only steady-decode window of the actual parent model run. Exclude startup, graph capture, isolated microtests and CPU-only annotations.
additional_parent_checks: Verify compact TP all-gathers replace full target and draft vocabulary gathers in eligible sampling ranges, while both original LM-head GEMMs still execute.
Verify _greedy_verify_and_count is specialized with TP_SIZE=4 and synthetic rates from the unchanged rejection sampler; no acceptance shortcut or disabled rejection path.

Confirm the normal three Eagle3 draft steps and all original target/draft model, attention, router and MoE kernels remain active. Kernel presence alone does not prove execution counts or numerical correctness.
Any missing target or draft kernel on any rank invalidates activation evidence; fix configuration or report the arm inactive before attributing performance.

validation.cpu: Python -B unit tests, source pins, exact patch reversibility, syntax checks, eligibility/fallback tests, activation-checker tests and ruff --no-cache. No real torch, Triton or vLLM imports in CPU tests.
parent_correctness: Validate actual target and draft token IDs against original A0 on C4 correctness runs, checking sampled/rejected counts and synthetic acceptance behavior on all TP ranks.

Exercise ordinary greedy and unchanged synthetic rates, ties/NaNs/infinities, shard/block boundaries, identity mapping, ragged batches, invalid draft placeholders, partial prefill, and graph replay of the dynamic draft token count.
Existing A33 helper evidence may support the unchanged kernels, but does not validate the new A0 wiring or substitute for runtime activation and A0 correctness.

parent_performance.gate: Correctness and actual activation, not a positive microbenchmark gain
parent_performance.rules: Reuse saved original A0. Run every correctness-valid independent arm once, including flat/negative arms; no cumulative comparison, baseline retiming, selective retest, C4 performance, or AgenticX performance.

validation.status: CPU implementation only; no Docker build, GPU execution, correctness or performance claim
